title: Loci
description: Cross-platform app surfacing nearby content via a custom GeoJSON radius algorithm; backed by a REST API with an admin portal built for data compliance, and a CI/CD pipeline with automated app store submissions.

title: Vineries.ca
description: Winery aggregator with tour booking and a self-serve owner management portal; deployed via a CI/CD pipeline that enforces dependency ordering to guarantee module compatibility.

title: Vaccine Passport (SHC)
description: A native Android application with a custom implementation of the SHC (Smart Health Card) protocol to read/generate QR codes; published to the app store with 5k+ users.

title: Garlicoin
description: Satirical cryptocurrency featured in Forbes; $1.5M market cap and $50k+ 24h volume. Modified Litecoin with the "allium" ASIC-resistant proof-of-work algorithm.
